subject: MAP: POC environment runbook — API keys & peering cutover
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Barnes <alice@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: POC environment runbook — API keys & peering cutover

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time on yesterday's call. Per our MAP discussion I put together an initial runbook for the POC environment setup so we can lock the close timeline. Attached: MAP_Runbook_v0.1.pdf (runbook) and peering-diagram.png (logical VPC flow).

High-level asks (we can split across owners in the MAP):
- Org & admin: confirm HelixHealth tenant name and the email of the primary org admin (we need an org admin for Redwood to provision the evaluation org).
- API keys: do you want short-lived eval API keys (recommended) or a persistent service key for the POC? If persistent, please identify the owner for rotation.
- IP allowlist: provide the egress CIDRs for any HelixHealth proxies that will call Redwood (we'll add to our allowlist and provide STS).
- VPC peering: point of contact + cloud account ID for peering. We recommend a peering for heavier throughput tests.

Proposed timeline (please confirm):
- Tue 10/14: org admin & API key modality confirmed
- Wed 10/15: IP allowlist & initial key issued; lightweight smoke test
- Thu 10/16: VPC peering request initiated; throughput validation window (if peering accepted)

Can you confirm owners and whether the above dates work for Helix? If you want, we can add a short preflight call (20 min) on Tue morning to walk through the runbook.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_Runbook_v0.1.pdf, peering-diagram.png
From: Alice Barnes <alice@helixhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Barnes <tom@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2025-10-13T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment runbook — API keys & peering cutover

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear runbook. Quick answers below:
- Org admin: jane.simmons@helixhealth.com (she's our cloud infra admin).
- API key: for the POC we'd prefer a short-lived eval key tied to our test tenant — rotation handled by Helix.
- IP allowlist: our egress CIDRs are 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/26 (we'll confirm precisely by EOD).
- VPC peering: please send us the peering request template; I will route to our networking team (contact is Tom Barnes).

The proposed dates look fine — Tue preflight would be helpful. Can you do 10/14 9:30am PT?

Best,
Alice Barnes
Director, Integrations — HelixHealth
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Barnes <alice@helixhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-14T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment runbook — API keys & peering cutover

On Tue, Oct 13, 2025 at 9:12 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> High-level asks...

Thanks, Alice — this is helpful. A couple of implementation notes from Infra side:
- For short-lived eval keys we'll provision scoped tokens that expire in 7 days and a refresh path for the POC. Please confirm whether Helix wants client-side rotation or for Redwood to handle refresh on your behalf.
- For the IP allowlist: once you confirm exact ranges we'll add them to the env and provide a signed cert thumbprint for mutual TLS if you want encrypted egress.
- VPC peering template: attached in the runbook appendix; I'll paste the minimal fields we need during the preflight (account ID, VPC ID, region, route table owner).

Neha — looping you in to coordinate peering approval windows and to own the internal peering ticket.

Next steps for Tue 10/14 9:30am PT preflight: 20-min call to validate admin access, confirm CIDRs, and start API key provisioning. Jonas will run the call.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachment references: MAP_Runbook_v0.1.pdf (appendix: peering template)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Barnes <alice@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2025-10-15T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment runbook — API keys & peering cutover

Ben / Jonas / Alice —

Quick infra checklist before we open the peering request:
1) Confirm Helix VPC ID + region (needed in the peering template).
2) Confirm route table owner (sometimes Helix's central network team manages route table changes; we need the approver).
3) Confirm whether Helix requires a shared secret or BGP (Redwood supports simple AWS VPC peering; if Helix wants Transit Gateway we need to escalate).

Alice — if Tom or Jane can paste the VPC ID and indicate route table owner in the reply that will let me create the AWS peering request and set the expected approval SLA (we usually see a 24–48 hour approval window).

I can own the peering ticket and coordinate follow-ups; once accepted we'll schedule the throughput window for Thu 10/16 afternoon (16:00–18:00 PT).

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Infra PM — Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Barnes <alice@helixhealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-16T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: POC environment runbook — API keys & peering cutover

Thanks everyone — last sync and confirmation: 

- Owners confirmed: Jane Simmons (jane.simmons@helixhealth.com) = org admin; Tom Barnes (tom@helixhealth.com) = networking approver.
- IP ranges confirmed: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.0/26 (Redwood has them on allowlist).
- API key: short-lived eval token (7d expiry) — Redwood will provision and send key material to Jane via the agreed secure channel.
- VPC peering: Neha to open peering request now (Helix VPC ID: vpc-0a1b2c3d, region: us-west-2; route table owner: Tom Barnes).

Immediate next steps (action owners):
- Neha: open peering request and confirm approval SLA (target: 24–48h).
- Jonas: provision short-lived eval key once org admin confirms receipt method.
- Alice/Tom/Jane: confirm peering approval and allowlist validation after their internal review.

If there are any blockers I can jump on a quick call. Otherwise we will treat Thu 10/16 16:00–18:00 PT as our throughput validation window pending peering acceptance.

Regards,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
